outcome.technical: audit-task.py: _create_then now stages the first plan at a sibling name (<manifest>.creating), runs the body against it, and os.replace()s it onto the real path only when the body returns 0; the staged file is removed on any non-zero/raise. Chose the sibling-temp route (not build-once-in-memory) because both creating bodies (_locked_phase_add, _locked_batch_add) read/validate/rollback through the on-disk manifest path, so a one-write restructure would rewrite both; journal location is derived from dirname only so it is unaffected. The two create=True callers' lambdas take an emit param (default out) and _create_then passes an emit that rewrites the staged name to the real one, so 'written:' and --json name the real plan. Evidence: live run in a fresh git repo, `add-phase T --outcome o` ok, only docs/audit/audit-plan.json present afterward, no .creating file; `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py --selftest` -> 1011/1011 cases passed, exit 0. No new test added (task tests.add is none and tests/ is outside files); the requested pin (body inspects path while running; body raising) is NOT yet written - owed as a follow-up task on test_audit_task.py. Gates not run (own-tests, nothing of its own).
